description: Department of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources - The Issuance of Certificates of Competence for Skippers (Local Fishing Boats) Regulations - 2019
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Fisheries under the Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Act, No. 2 of 1996. It specifically amends existing regulations regarding the issuance and revocation of skipper licenses. This content falls under legal/regulatory matters as it involves statutory instruments and regulatory frameworks for fisheries operations, making it Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes).
